ops.text: 5.5 Ownership. As between the Parties, the Company shall own all right, title and interest in and to (i) the Site and all deliverables and work product created for the Company under this Agreement (including the design, look and feel and all HTML, graphics and text developed by or for HDI for the Site), (ii) the Content, and (iii) all customer, order, transaction and user data collected through or generated by the Site, including customer e-mail lists relating to Deerskin Products (collectively, the "Company Data"), and the Company retains all rights in the Company Data. HDI hereby assigns to the Company all right, title and interest it may have in such deliverables and work product. HDI shall retain ownership of its pre-existing intellectual property, and hereby grants the Company a perpetual, irrevocable, royalty-free license to any HDI intellectual property embedded in the deliverables. Nothing in this Agreement shall create joint ownership of the Site, the deliverables, the work product, the Content or the Company Data.

proposal.comment: [Playbook] The Agreement is silent on ownership although HDI develops and hosts the Site using our Content and our customer data, so we have added a clause under which we own the deliverables and work product created for us and retain all rights in the Company Data, HDI assigns those rights and keeps its pre-existing IP with a perpetual, irrevocable, royalty-free licence to us for any HDI IP embedded in the deliverables, and no joint ownership arises. This is our preferred position that we own what we pay for and what we put in.
